Subject: Citrine Labs + Redwood: LlamaIndex / tracing integration

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro last quarter — Citrine's product team has been evaluating embedding + retrieval flows at scale and we think Redwood's runtime could be a great fit, especially if we can plug in LlamaIndex tracing and preserve prompt-level observability.

High-level ask: we'd like to prototype an integration so Citrine's retrieval+prompt pipeline (LlamaIndex backed by our vector store) can emit traces and token attribution to Redwood's observability hooks, and optionally fall back to a LangChain-based adapter for some legacy connectors. The things we'd like to validate in a short pilot (4–6 weeks):
- trace propagation from LlamaIndex -> Redwood trace API
- SDK adapter that keeps prompt chunks and token attribution intact
- acceptable latency envelope for multi-turn retrieval (95th percentile < 150ms extra overhead)
- mapping of Citrine's RBAC keys to Redwood customer tokens for audit logs

I attached a draft SOW and a quick architecture sketch to give context (citrine-sow-draft.pdf, citrine-arch.png). Links: https://github.com/citrine-labs/llama-integration-samples

Could you point me to the right engineering contact on your side for technical scoping? We'd also like an initial pricing/commitment ballpark so our procurement team can start internal approvals.

Proposed next step: 30-min tech sync w/ your infra/integration PM. Are you available next week?

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Head of Integrations, Citrine Labs

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Citrine Labs + Redwood: LlamaIndex / tracing integration

Forwarding Citrine's note — a couple of internal thoughts before the sync that Marissa can use to prep. Quoting Claire's last email below for context.

Quick runbook items we should confirm internally:
- Adapter approach: prefer authoring a redwood-trace-adapter for LlamaIndex rather than instrumenting Citrine's app directly. That lets us offer a reusable package to other ISVs.
- LangChain compat: ensure the adapter exposes a LangChain shim (many customers want both) — LlamaIndex and LangChain call patterns differ for cache/streaming, so test both.
- Token attribution: we need to validate token-level accounting when LlamaIndex does chunked prompting + rerank. We should document the mapping (prompt chunk -> trace span -> token counts).
- Latency target: 150ms added overhead is acceptable but we should instrument continuous batching impacts (batch size, KV cache hits).
- Security: confirm whether Citrine requires HSM-backed signing for audit logs; if so, loop Legal and Security early.

Marissa — can you draft a 1-page integration checklist (technical acceptance criteria + test harness) and attach it to our reply? I started a checklist named redwood-integration-checklist.md locally (attached). Also include a small code snippet that shows how a customer would enable the adapter (we should show both node/python).

If we want to move fast, we can offer a 2-week engineering ramp (dev pool) + a 2-week dedicated perf window; procurement pricing for pilot: $Xk/month for the dedicated window (we'll refine once we get Citrine's scale numbers).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
